# beowulf-fitt-43 — cruces and choices

Units: 14, lines 3137-3182. No dot-under-vowel explanation was needed in a note of its own beyond one sentence (unit 3163, nīðhēdịge); the sign was first explained in fitt 03.

- 3139 helm[um] behongen: MS helm; Grein adds -um (participle agreeing with ād, "hung with helmets"). Thorkelin and others read verb behēngon. Chose the participle.
- 3140 swā hē bēna wæs: "as he was a petitioner", rendered "as he had asked". The request for arms on the pyre is not in the text (Wiglaf relays only the barrow, 3094 ff.); marked as a guess.
- 3143 on beorge: "on the hill", not "barrow", since the mound is not yet built; guess, flagged.
- 3145 swioðole: hapax; MS swicðole; chose "blaze/flame" (guess); Tho.'s "Swedish pine" mentioned.
- 3145 lēg: MS let; Tho. lēg. "flame".
- 3146 windblond gelæg: "the wind-commotion lay down" (wind dropped); Grimm's [ne] gelæg (reverse) mentioned. blond = "tumult" (guess).
- 3148 hāt on hreðre: fire hot at the breast (guess), alternative left open.
- 3150 (s)īo geōmēowle: MS (s)ia, with Latin anus written over; "old woman". Italic o = Klaeber's change of a; geō conjectured by E. Sc.
- 3151 (b)undenheorde: guess "bound-haired"; alternative heorte "heart" (Grein, per apparatus). Bugge's restoration of 3151a-3155a adopted; note says round brackets there are his reconstruction.
- 3152 sǣde: MS sælðe (not a word); secgan past.
- 3154 worn: MS wonn; wælfylla worn "multitude of slaughters". (wīgen)des egesan: "a warrior's terrors" (Zupitza's one-day reading).
- 3155 hȳ[n]ðo: MS hyðo; [n] added. "humiliations".
- 3157 [h]liðe: MS liðe; Tho. adds h; Holt/Schü hliðe[s nōsan] mentioned.
- 3160 bronda lāfe: "leavings of the brands" (after homera lāfe); read as pyre-remains.
- 3163 bēg: short plural of bēag; Tho. bēag[as] mentioned.
- 3165 nīðhēdịge men: "hate-minded men" (guess), taken as the Geats who removed the hoard; dot sentence given.
- 3170 twelfe: MS twelfa; E. Sc. twelfe. "twelve in all".
- 3171 (care): MS illegible; ceare "sorrow" standard; [ond] from Sievers etc.
- 3172 w(er): Grein; "the man".
- 3174 duguðum dēmdon: guess, "judged them according to worth" (dative of manner); no sure grip.
- 3177 līchaman: italic ī; MS lachaman, Zupitza: late hand's error. (lǣded): Klaeber after Trautmann(?)/Holthausen/Chambers; rivals lǣne, lǣnum, lȳsed listed.
- 3180 wyruldcyning[a]: MS -cyning; Klaeber adds genitive plural. l/i follow the genitive plural reading ("of world-kings"); the singular alternative is stated in the note.
- 3181 mon(ðw)ǣrust: Gru. tr. restoration; "most gentle to men".
- 3182 lofgeornost: "most praise-eager"; the question whether it carries reproach is stated and the choice (praise) flagged as a guess. Candidate for QUESTIONS.md (famous crux, no house rendering; recorded here for the orchestrator).

Renderings used: Gēata lēode "people of the Geats"; Wedra lēode "people of the Weders" (i: Geats); hlāford "lord"; mondryhten "liege-lord"; winedryhten "friend-lord"; bānhūs "bone-house" / "house of bone"; heorðgenēatas "hearth-companions"; hildebord "battle-boards"; bēna "petitioner". New: giōmorgyd "sad-song" / "lament"; wudurēc "wood-smoke"; bǣlfȳr "pyre-fire"; beadurōf "battle-bold"; wordgyd "word-song"; ellenweorc "valor-work"; eorlscipe "noble-deed"; lofgeornost "most praise-eager"; monðwǣrust "most gentle to men" (l: "most men-gentle").
